title: Example 22-1: Bibliography

illustrates.quote: List each bibliography entry using 1-3 margins. See Formats, §22.3 to learn how to format annotated bibliographies.

blocks.text: Leiber, M. J., and Jamieson, K. M. 1995. Race and Decision making within juvenile justice: The importance of context. Journal of Quantitative Criminology 11(4)363-388.
blocks.features: Hanging indent (first line at margin, runovers indented). 'Journal of Quantitative Criminology' in italics.

blocks.text: Poupart, L. 1995. The overrepresentation of minority youths in the California juvenile justice administration: Racial disparities in an urban juvenile court. In Minorities in Juvenile Justice edited by K. K. Leonard, C. E. Pope, and W. Feyerherm. Thousand Oaks, CA: Sage Publications.
blocks.features: Hanging indent. 'Minorities in Juvenile Justice' in italics.
